engine: v2 crawl + basic checks + 5 function testers

plan.product_type: e-commerce store (simple online shop selling everyday goods)
plan.summary: ShopLite is a small e-commerce site where users browse and purchase everyday items (totes, bottles, lamps, notebooks). The demo should showcase the full shopping flow from login through product browsing to cart, plus order management and the admin panel.

demo_journeys.name: Shop & Add to Cart
steps: Log in with Bob Tester credentials
Land on the Shop page and browse the product grid
Click on 'Desk Lamp' to open its product detail page
Click 'Add to cart' on the product page
Navigate to the Cart and confirm the item appears

demo_journeys.name: Review & Delete Order
steps: Open the Orders page
Review the existing order #1000 (1 item, $45.00)
Click 'Delete' on the order to demonstrate order removal

demo_journeys.name: Account & Admin Overview
steps: Open Account, edit the display name, and click Save
Switch to the Admin panel and review the user list (Bob Tester / user, Alice Admin / admin)

report.summary: The verdict on the e-commerce store is not safe to demo, with 10 critical failures found across 13 pages. These include errors on anonymous access to several root pages, an overflow on the orders page, and broken Help and Continue shopping links, plus unresolved desktop-versus-phone layout checks. Of the full test run, 412 checks passed, but 181 remain untested and 4 are blocked, alongside 2 non-critical failures.
